name: Create mapping
description: Create mapping Creates a mapping between a Cloudflare account and an email provider for DLP email scanning integration. POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/dlp/email/account_mapping
context:
POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/dlp/email/account_mapping
Creates a mapping between a Cloudflare account and an email provider for DLP email scanning integration.
Required: account_id (path); body (body) — Account mapping.

name: Create email scanner rule
description: Create email scanner rule Creates a new DLP email scanning rule that defines what content patterns to detect in email messages and what actions to take. POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/dlp/email/rules
context:
POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/dlp/email/rules
Creates a new DLP email scanning rule that defines what content patterns to detect in email messages and what actions to take.
Required: account_id (path); body (body) — Rule description.

name: Delete email scanner rule
description: Delete email scanner rule Removes a DLP email scanning rule. DELETE /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/dlp/email/rules/{rule_id}

name: Get mapping
description: Get mapping Retrieves the email provider mapping configuration for DLP email scanning. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/dlp/email/account_mapping
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/dlp/email/account_mapping
Retrieves the email provider mapping configuration for DLP email scanning.
Required: account_id (path)

name: Get an email scanner rule
description: Get an email scanner rule Gets detailed configuration for a specific DLP email scanning rule, including detection patterns and actions. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/dlp/email/rules/{rule_id}

name: List all email scanner rules
description: List all email scanner rules Lists all email scanner rules for an account. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/dlp/email/rules
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/dlp/email/rules
Lists all email scanner rules for an account.
Required: account_id (path)

name: Update email scanner rule
description: Update email scanner rule Updates a DLP email scanning rule. PUT /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/dlp/email/rules/{rule_id}

name: Update email scanner rule priorities
description: Update email scanner rule priorities Reorders DLP email scanning rules by updating their priority values. PATCH /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/dlp/email/rules
context:
PATCH /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/dlp/email/rules
Reorders DLP email scanning rules by updating their priority values. Higher priority rules are evaluated first.
Required: account_id (path); body (body) — Rule priorities.
